caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with an intricate decorative pattern rendered primarily in red and white. The textile features a central area with white floral and foliage motifs arranged symmetrically on a red background, incorporating curving stems and flower clusters. Surrounding the central area is a wide border filled with scrolling, floral designs, also in white on red. The textile includes a fringe along two adjacent sides, with stylized, irregular tassels depicted in red. A corner of the textile is folded over to reveal the underside, which maintains the same color scheme and pattern. The entire composition is presented against a plain, light-colored background, allowing the red-and-white pattern and motifs to stand out.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
